## Description {#details}

Complex expressions can be checked in a single line, using the logical <code>mt::&#95;and()</code>, <code>mt::&#95;or()</code> and <code>mt::&#95;not()</code> functions.


:::info
The names are prefixed with underscore since <code>and</code>, <code>or</code> and <code>not</code> are reserved words in C/C++.
:::


<SectionUser title="Example">

</SectionUser>


<ProgramListing extension="cpp">

<CodeLine><Highlight kind="normal">mt::expect(mt::&#95;and (mt::eq (compute&#95;answer (), 42), mt::eq (compute&#95;float (), 42.0)));</Highlight></CodeLine>

</ProgramListing>


:::info
If operands are function comparators, it is recommended to use the overloaded logical operators <code>&amp;&amp;</code>, <code>||</code>, <code>!</code> available in the <code>micro&#95;test&#95;plus::operators</code> namespace.
:::
